description: Build a puppetsync repos_config hash from the GitHub API: list an org's repos and keep the ones puppetsync can sync (live, non-empty, matching the include/exclude filters, and accepting contributions). The selection rule and its edges are stated once, in the header of tasks/list_github_repos.rb. Branches come from each repo's default_branch. Unknown or retired source keys are rejected.

source.description: Filter configuration: {org, include, exclude, force_include, include_topics, exclude_topics, exclude_archived}

github_authtoken.description: GitHub API token (optional but strongly recommended: unauthenticated requests are heavily rate-limited)

repos.description: Repo objects to filter instead of querying the API (for testing)
